summary: The Phoenix dossiers are factually sound on the Suns team facts, schedule dates, arena naming and All-Star details, all of which match the verified CURRENT FACTS. I corrected the Los Suns first-worn year (2011 to May 2010) in uniform and rhythm, Barrio Cafe's location (16th Street, not Grand Avenue), the Heard Hoop Dance Contest date (Feb 6-7, 2027, not an All-Star overlap, confirmed live), the WM Phoenix Open name and timing, a non-court South Mountain Park entry, Lalo Guerrero's origin and the 'Latino-majority' wording. Live checks confirmed First Friday is Artlink-run and monthly, and could not confirm Majerle's downtown status. The brief needs edits: the hoop dance overlap, Roosevelt Row CDC vs Artlink for First Friday, the Latino-majority wording, and a hard dependency on the unverified 2026-27 City Edition, Arizona Latino Arts and Cultural Center, Desert Sky Mall, Nike Factory Store and Majerle's.
